h2: Pool Repair Nusa Dua – Leaks, Tiles & Pipework Fixed
intro: If your villa pool in Nusa Dua is losing water, showing cloudy patches, or has tiles starting to pop, Pool Repair Nusa Dua services from Bali Fix can sort it before guests notice. Many installations across Tanjung Benoa and Bualu are now 15–20 years old, so small issues tend to compound if left unchecked. Send a few photos on WhatsApp and I'll tell you exactly what needs fixing first.

sections.h3: Why Pools Here Wear Out Faster
sections.text: Salt-laden coastal air combined with Bukit's hard water accelerates corrosion on ladders, skimmer baskets, heater coils and valve fittings. In gated estates around Sawangan, large overflow pools and water features put extra strain on pipework and pumps. Because many of these systems date back 15–20 years, I usually start by checking which components are nearing the end of their service life so we address root causes rather than chasing symptoms one drip at a time.

sections.h3: What I Typically Handle in Villa Pools
sections.text: The most common calls involve slow leaks around the main drain or return jets, loose mosaic tiles after a busy season, cracked grout letting sand into the filter, and pipe joints weeping behind the equipment shed. For resort-style pools with overflows and fountains, balancing chemistry and inspecting pump seals fold into the same visit. Every job is scoped from your photos beforehand, so there are no surprises when I arrive.

sections.h3: How to Get a Quote via WhatsApp
sections.text: Snap two or three clear photos – a wide shot of the affected area, a close-up of the tile or crack, and ideally a short clip showing the drip rate. Send them on WhatsApp along with your villa name and a nearby landmark so I can plan the route. I'll come back with a rough scope and confirm timing, factoring in any gated-estate access requirements for that day.

In Nusa Dua's coastal climate, a monthly check of skimmer seals, valve gaskets and heater connections catches corrosion before it becomes an active leak. Brushing grout lines quarterly stops sand packing into joints and weakening the substrate beneath. If your pool has an overflow channel, keep it free of algae build-up so water doesn't back up behind the wall. Small preventive attention now saves a full re-tile job later, especially where pools run year-round like in Tanjung Benoa.

faq.q: How do you locate a hidden pool leak?
faq.a: I isolate sections of pipework, monitor pressure drops, then inspect fittings, the main drain and underground connections until the source is confirmed. Once identified, I send a repair quote over WhatsApp before any work begins.

faq.q: Do you work inside gated estates in Nusa Dua?
faq.a: Yes – just include the estate name when booking on WhatsApp so I can arrange gate access with management ahead of time. Scheduling a day or two early avoids delays at the entrance.

faq.q: Can you reset loose mosaic tiles without draining the whole pool?
faq.a: In most cases yes; I remove the affected section, clean the substrate, and reset the tiles while surrounding water stays in place. For larger patches or structural concerns we'll discuss whether a partial drain makes more sense.
